preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**6 for n, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('t')))
preconditions.description: Each test case has n (array size) satisfying 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= (n // 2) for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('t')))
preconditions.description: Each test case has m (set B size) satisfying 1 ≤ m ≤ floor(n/2).

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for a in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and 'a' in line.lower()))
preconditions.description: Each array a has exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= (n // 2) for n, b_i in ((n, int(b)) for n, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('t')) for line in [stdin.splitlines()[i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 3)]))
preconditions.description: Each element b_i in set B satisfies 1 ≤ b_i ≤ floor(n/2).

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in a for a in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and 'a' in line.lower()))
preconditions.description: Each element in array a satisfies -10^9 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(b)) == len(b) for b in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and 'b' in line.lower()))
preconditions.description: Set B contains distinct positive integers.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() == str(max_sum) for stdout in (line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()) for max_sum in (compute_max_sum(n, a, B) for n, a, B in parse_input(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum possible sum of array a after applying any number of operations (each operation flips signs of an interval of size x ∈ B).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(max_sum, int) for max_sum in (compute_max_sum(n, a, B) for n, a, B in parse_input(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer representing the maximum sum.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**18 <= max_sum <= 10**18 for max_sum in (compute_max_sum(n, a, B) for n, a, B in parse_input(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The output sum is within the range of possible sums given the constraints.
